description.en: A sidebar work todo panel with priorities, due dates, projects, overdue and this-week views. Todos persist across sessions in the Harness storage layer, and worktodo_* tools let the agent read and write the same list as the user.
description.zh: 侧栏工作待办面板：优先级、截止日期、项目、逾期与本周视图。待办跨会话持久保存在 Harness 存储层，并提供 worktodo_* 工具，让 agent 与用户读写同一份列表。
